messages:
Marta: seeing spike in apiserver 503s in eu-west-2 starting ~2026-02-18T10:12Z. controller-manager leader flips every ~15-25s. etcd leader stuck on az-b1.
Leo: confirmed. apiserver pods show fd exhaustion and lots of TIME_WAIT. connections to etcd followers flapping.
ops-bot: [ALERT] etcd leader-change detected (etcd-03) at 2026-02-18T10:13:02Z
Jing: etcd-03 logs have repeated: "heartbeat timed out" + "peer read timeout" + "connection reset". network telemetry shows retransmit bursts toward nat gateway in az-b1.
Marta: provider reported maintenance on transit for az-b1 around the same time — possible BGP route churn.
Leo: conntrack table on apiserver frontends spiked ~110k entries, kernel fd limit hit on kube-proxy hosts. kube-apiserver process exhausted files.
Andrew: parallel issue: new GPU nodes (g4) failing TLS handshakes during join in eu-west-2; autoscaler backed off. Backfill stalled.
Marta: customer impact: some Dedicated GPU allocations failing, job startups timing out. overall control-plane instability is root cause.
Jing: quick mitigation proposal:
- raise apiserver ulimit (soft) from 65536 -> 200000 via systemd override DaemonSet
- increase controller-manager leader lease from 15s -> 45s (renew-deadline 30s)
- scale apiserver replicas 3 -> 5 but constrain pods to az-a and az-c preferring healthy network
- mark az-b1 control-plane endpoints as degraded and avoid scheduling new control-plane pods there
Leo: full list of actions and small config snippets:
```
# controller-manager flags
--leader-elect=true
--leader-elect-lease-duration=45s
--leader-elect-renew-deadline=30s
```
```
# systemd override for apiserver
[Service]
LimitNOFILE=200000
```
Marta: low-risk first: apply ulimit change via DaemonSet across control-plane nodes in az-a/c, then scale apiserver. Jing, can you canary the controller-manager flag in staging?
Jing: yes will run canary in staging then prod.
Andrew: infra will coordinate apiserver scale and taint az-b1 control-plane nodes. pre-approving bandwidth overage up to $5k/day to keep GPUs online. I'll also open an escalation with provider for the BGP/maintenance.
ops-bot: incident INC-2026-2249 created (severity=high) assigned -> eng-sre.
Samantha: assigned to GPU backfill runbook. I'll validate rollback plan for autoscaler and be ready to shift reserved pool traffic to eu-west-1 if needed.
Leo: postmortem action items: better BGP route-change alerts, conntrack/fd throttling rules, proactive control-plane placement during AZ maintenance windows, and autoscaler backoff tuning for TLS handshake retries.
Marta: scheduling a debrief 2026-02-19 09:00 UTC. rolling the ulimit + controller-manager lease change in 2m. keeping everyone posted. :rocket:
